entries.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, faithful reconstruction from the supplied visual master.
Recreate this exact game result card at high resolution. Treat the supplied image as a locked design, not inspiration. Match its silhouettes, exact proportions and positions, asymmetrical cartoon toy tower, typography shapes, blue/yellow palette, highlights, clouds, confetti and overlaps. NO redesign or invented improvement.
Canvas approximately 1192 x 1344 (same 298:336 ratio as input), face-on UI. Preserve the card outer white rounded rectangle at x1%-95.6%, y6%-98%, with the small blue X close button protruding at upper right, exact as reference. Replace only the tiny outside-image background scraps above and beside the card with genuine transparency; do not include cropped home logo or city beyond the panel. Do not crop the close button or tower.
Inside preserve ALL of these: short THIN white irregular title paper near upper-left/center, dark navy Chinese 本次叠到了; giant chunky rounded vivid yellow 42.7m text with bright yellow top and thick deep-blue lower extrusion, m smaller than digits and touching them, slight playful baseline tilt; red irregular 新纪录！ sticker below the score; leaning stack of mismatched toy blocks on right from top to just above button: cheerful yellow duck in a red slipper hat, white smiling cube below, short blue-gray block band, orange hollow chunky bricks, orange/yellow block, angled deep-blue base. Small thin WHITE tilted bubble at right saying 太棒了！, NO heavy blue square bubble. Broad rounded white information area below record at left with two columns: 本次技术分 above 2680; 超过了 above 92% 的玩家. To its right a small bright cyan rounded square share control with little dark camera icon and correct Chinese 分享. Wide FLAT yellow capsule along bottom, not tall/puffy: red play triangle at left and dark navy 再来一局 to its right, same width and edge padding as reference.
Keep all content at the original positions. Full text exactly: 本次叠到了 | 42.7m | 新纪录！ | 太棒了！ | 本次技术分 | 2680 | 超过了 | 92% 的玩家 | 分享 | 再来一局.
Do not substitute objects with a toilet or fridge, do not make the tower straight, do not add a logo/avatar/topbar. This is a full visual draft of a game card, all sample numbers intentionally fixed for art review. Render as newly reconstructed sharp polished illustration retaining all the distinctive original graphic design. True transparent outside perimeter, not black/white checkerboard.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the APPROVED visual master; image2 is a high-resolution recreation needing three precise repairs.
Edit image2, preserve its composition, panel aspect ratio, positions, colors, toy stack and Chinese content. Match image1 more precisely:
1) The title 本次叠到了 is a thin short irregular white paper sticker. Remove the TWO speech tails hanging below the title in image2. Original is NOT a chat bubble, NOT a thick plastic button. Keep same text size and playful tilt.
2) In 42.7m, make only m smaller: its visible yellow height approximately 60% of the tall 7 height; snug right beside 7 at the same bottom baseline with essentially no extra gap. Keep 42.7 unchanged.
3) Outside the panel and close-button silhouette produce REAL alpha transparency. Remove the painted gray checkerboard pixels completely. Do not draw checkerboard or black/white background. Entire image2 canvas preserved; no crop of X or duck hat or border.
Keep everything else: white card and blue cloud rays, duck block tower, red 新纪录！ sticker, 太棒了！ bubble, labels 本次技术分 and 超过了, 2680, 92% 的玩家, 分享, bottom 再来一局. No typography modernization or new shadows; faithfully preserve all other details. Finished complete visual draft.

Use case: precise-object-edit. From the attached approved game result card, reconstruct ONLY its white rounded two-column information panel as a standalone high-resolution transparent PNG. This is the white shape containing 本次技术分 / 2680 at left and 超过了 / 92% 的玩家 at right.
Keep the exact original silhouette: broad 209:70 proportion, soft round left corners, slightly bulging organic curved right end, smooth bright white fill, extremely subtle cool shadow. There is no blue border. Retain the small fixed dark-blue top headings 本次技术分 at left and 超过了 at right, and the smaller fixed words 的玩家 near the bottom right. Leave blank spaces for the changing 2680 and92% values: DO NOT render any digits or percent symbol. Gentle thin pale vertical divider between columns if visible in source. Lower whitespace suitable for separate dark-navy runtime digits. NO speech tail, no big notch, no 3D button thickness. All Chinese words must be exact. True alpha outside, no painted checkerboard, no sky, no other card, no tower or record badge. A tight finished isolated UI component, about1200x400 pixels, no redesign.

Use case: stylized-concept. Recreate the SCORE LETTERING from the supplied approved game card as one production GLYPH ATLAS. Use the giant yellow 42.7m as the exact style target: very heavy friendly rounded inflated chunky game digits, yellow front face with subtle lighter top, substantial dark royal-blue lower/right thickness, small pale outer highlight. Do NOT modernize the font or use thin Arial.
Atlas contains exactly 12 isolated symbols, no others. Regular layout SIX columns and TWO rows, each cell same size, each glyph clearly separated from neighbors by generous transparent space. Row1: 0 1 2 3 4 5. Row2: 6 7 8 9 . m. Glyphs upright for later placement, same cap height and baseline for the ten digits, same material/shading/extrusion directions. The decimal dot is small, m lowercase about60% digit cap height and bottom aligned. True transparent background over the WHOLE atlas, no actual gray checkerboard pixels, no blue panel. Each symbol is an independent isolated cutout, no touching blue outlines. No cell borders, labels, rulers, captions. Output at least1800x700-like ratio3:1 so each digit has legible shape, absolutely all12 symbols fully visible. Exact style match to the source game's score, not generic gold coins or metallic text.
